title: Yoisaki Kanade — Burning Resolve〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'll make myself some tea...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I managed to tell Mafuyu's mom everything that I needed her to hear...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I agree that Mafuyu and I will need to have a little heart to heart...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Which should give her an opportunity to see that she doesn't need your silly, little group and that becoming a doctor is what's best for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll be back to normal after we've had a chance to talk things over...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't believe a word you're saying...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I refuse to leave Mafuyu's side...
Regardless of what you say...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If things keep up, Mafuyu's true feelings are going to be suppressed completely by her mom.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Just when she's finally figured out how to say what she herself wants to do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But even that little wish was pulverized...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Again, I don't believe that she has Mafuyu's best interests in mind...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She severely restricts what her daughter's allowed to do... Including expressing how she feels... She's treating Mafuyu like a...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, you're really pale!
What happened? You're not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(That marionette Mafuyu saw...
It made her feel sick because...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's mom has been trying to keep her from doing or feeling what she wants, and she really hates it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (As a result, she began losing sight of who she really is...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (While living in that horrible environment this whole time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I felt shivers run down my spine as I spoke with Mafuyu's mom... Even after coming home, my hands still feel so cold...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh no! I left the water running...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right. I was going to make tea...
Let's see. Which one should I have...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (There's still some of the herbal tea Ms. Mochizuki brought over the other day. I'll have some of that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This tea has such a nice aroma to it.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I think she said that it's supposed to help you relax and clear your mind.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's only every once in a while, but I really appreciate how she puts so much thought into what teas to bring over...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Not just my hands and the rest of my body, but... My heart too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If only there was a way for me to share this warmth with Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I want to stay by her side.
No, I have to stay by her side.
